prs.title: Change "correct" to "appropriate" in 4.1.2 "in brief"
prs.author: patrickhlauke
prs.body:
throughout the body of the document, we talk about "appropriate" ... but the "in brief" mentions "correct", which is contentious. it implies that there is always a "correct" name/role/property/state, which is not necessarily the case.

a late follow-up to https://github.com/w3c/wcag/pull/2207 (where we put "appropriate" everywhere but missed this one out)

prs.title: Tweak two of the examples in 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
prs.author: patrickhlauke
prs.body:

* modify the US phone number example - mention the overarching label earlier, make it clear that we think the punctuation acts as a label. don't mention use of `title`, but `aria-label` instead. and cross-reference 4.1.2 because that aspect of giving an accessible name is NOT the concern of 3.3.2

closes #755
closes #4913

prs.title: Update Intent of Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
prs.author: bruce-usab
prs.body:
Relates to #3264

Adds paragraph to end of Intent for 3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced):
> This Success Criterion does not address creation of a username or initiating an account.  For many web sites, establishing an initial username is not significantly different than logging in with that username.  However, for many other web sites, the processes are quite different.  Moreover, the means used for creating an account vary more than the means used for re-authentication.  This is because initial authentication may require more due diligence with assuring the identity of a new user.  Another substantive difference between first authentication and re-authentication is that a third party, human or automated, is often required.

There is already a similar paragraph in Understanding 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum).

prs.title: Update error identification to add reference to 1.3.1 and remove some links to ARIA techniques
prs.author: fstrr
prs.body:
Closes #696

Note that some of issue 696 was dealt with in [PRs from 2024 and 2025](https://github.com/w3c/wcag/issues/696#issuecomment-5837022554).

This PR adds a sentence about using 1.3.1 Info And Relationships alongside the existing sentence abour 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. It also removes references to [ARIA2](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Techniques/aria/ARIA2), [ARIA19](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Techniques/aria/ARIA19), and [ARIA21](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Techniques/aria/ARIA21). Note that this will leave ARIA21 not being associated to any SCs.
